summary.intent: Plan and then auto-advance into executing Phase 62 (Unified Node Codec - Core Keystone) of CipherBox, which rewrites the core codec to use unified `Node` types with dual-sealed bodies and generation-as-AAD, replacing legacy metadata types across ~30 consumer files.
summary.outcome: Planning completed fully (9 plans / 7 waves, all gates passed: research HIGH-confidence, VALIDATION.md created, PATTERNS.md 14-analog map, plan-checker 15/15 after 1 revision round, coverage 6/6 reqs + 9/9 decisions). Execution was initiated and Wave 1 Plan 62-01 was spawned as a subagent; the transcript ends there with execution in flight.

repo: Nyquist validation requires a `## Validation Architecture` section in RESEARCH.md to generate VALIDATION.md; without research, plans lack Dimension-8 validation requirements.
Consumer test files referencing deleted types fail tsc before `describe.skip` evaluates — imports must be removed entirely, not just test bodies skipped.
Vault v3 blob golden vectors belong in `tests/vectors/` (loaded from file), not inline in PLAN.md, per D-04 and cross-language Rust parity requirements.
PATTERNS.md is not included in step 13d's plan commit (known gap in the workflow) — must be committed explicitly after pattern-mapper spawns.
The gsd commit helper can report `commit_failed` while the commit actually lands (lint-staged ran clean, 1Password SSH signed OK) — a known false-negative; do not retry.

`workflow.auto_advance: true` in config would normally chain planning straight into execute-phase; it's a config value, not a CLI flag, and must be consciously overridden for unsupervised keystone phases.
Drift precheck `action_required: warn` with `spawn_mapper: false` is non-blocking; the 143 flagged elements were all pre-existing (stale baseline map, not Phase 62 regressions).
Plan size threshold triggered a split: Plan 08 (~43 files) was split into 08a (web logic, wave 6) and 08b (web components + grep-discovered test quarantine + final root `pnpm typecheck`, wave 7).
API surface intel file is HINT-only and extracted 0 symbols for this phase — omit from planner prompt when empty.
Web quarantine for retired-type imports requires grep-based discovery across test files, not a static list, because the set of affected files is not known ahead of time.
workflow: For pnpm monorepos with a cross-package dist chain (core→sdk-core→sdk→web), sequential execution on one tree is more robust than parallel worktrees, which lack `node_modules` and require slow per-worktree `pnpm i`.

`--no-transition` stops execute-phase from auto-chaining into the next phase after completion; `--auto` auto-approves all checkpoints (useful combined with `autonomous: true` plans for unsupervised runs).
Node eval quoting bugs in bash are a real hazard when extracting structured fields from JSON/YAML blobs inline — prefer piping through `jq` or a dedicated query tool over inline eval.
The `gap-analysis` post-planning gate (step 13e) is a no-op when no `plan:post` hooks are active; coverage is verified independently by the coverage gates in 13/13a.
When a plan-checker returns a blocker + warnings on iteration 1, the right call is a targeted revision (not a full re-plan); the checker re-verifies all 15 dimensions clean on the next pass.
RESEARCH.md open questions should be marked `(RESOLVED)` with the resolution inline before the plans are finalized — the plan-checker gates on this as a blocker.

friction: gsd commit helper false-negative: reported `commit_failed` for the VALIDATION.md commit but `git log` confirmed it landed (`2475ae35d`); caused unnecessary confusion about whether to retry.
Requirements-coverage bash loop had a word-splitting display bug (printed all six NODE IDs as a single token), requiring a clean re-run to get a trustworthy result.
Node eval quoting bug when parsing execute-phase init output inline — required a second bash call with a cleaner extraction approach.
Drift precheck flagged 143 pre-existing elements as 'stale' with no way to distinguish Phase-62-specific regressions from baseline staleness without running `/gsd-map-codebase` first.
Schema-gate hook ran unnecessarily (scanned for ORM files in a crypto codec package) before concluding it was a silent skip — a hook that could short-circuit earlier on package path.
open_items: Phase 62 execution is in flight — Wave 1 Plan 62-01 was spawned as a subagent at transcript end; all 9 plans / 7 waves remain to be completed and verified.
~30 consumer stub files (sdk-core, sdk, web) are intentionally left with stub behavior pointing to owning phases (Phase 65 write-chain/share, Phase 66 DB schema, etc.).
Codebase map is stale (`/gsd-map-codebase` recommended) — non-blocking for Phase 62 but will cause continued drift-precheck noise on future phases.
`phase uat-passed` CLI command exists in help output but has no handler (pre-existing known issue, workaround: edit VERIFICATION.md + `phase complete`).
ROADMAP wave-dependency annotation was idempotent (already set by revision agent) — worth confirming the ROADMAP accurately reflects the 08a/08b split after execution completes.
